title: Average site area per grouped dwelling (Table 3B)
text: Minimum and average site area. C4.1.1 Development which complies with the dwelling type and site area provisions set out in Table 3B and the following provisions. Table 3B Site area requirements. Site area per dwelling (m2), Av: R2, R2.5, R5 -; R10 1000, R12.5 800, R15 666, R17.5 571, R20 450, R25 350 (each printed struck through); R30 300; R35 260; R40 220; R50 180; R60 150; R80 120; R100-SL No av applies. R80 site area provisions apply to all grouped dwellings located on lots coded R100, R160 and LR, MR and HR. - Indicated not applicable. Proposed change: Removal of average site area for R10 - R25 coded lots within the Perth and Peel Regions. Refer to Information Sheet 5: Lot size and density. Site area variations. Site area variations are subject to C4.1.1. C4.1.4 The following variations to the minimum and average site area set out in Table 3B may be made: i. in the case of a grouped dwelling; the area of a lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot approved by the WAPC; or ii. the area of any existing lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot with permanent legal access to a public road, notwithstanding that it is less than that required in Table 3B. C4.1.5 In areas coded R25 and below; for a small dwelling (in accordance with C2.9.1) that is the subject of a proposed development, the minimum and average site area of Table 3B may be reduced by up to 35 per cent. C4.1.6 In areas coded R30 to R40; for an accessible dwelling designed to gold level universal design (in accordance with C2.7.1), or a small dwelling (in accordance with C2.9.1) that is the subject of a development proposal, the minimum and average site area of Table 3B may be reduced by up to 35 per cent, provided that: i. for grouped dwellings, no site is less than 100m2; and ii. for development or subdivision of 4 or more dwellings or sites, the site area reduction is limited to a maximum 50 per cent of the total number of dwellings or sites. C4.1.7 In areas coded R50 and above; for an accessible dwelling designed to gold level universal design (in accordance with C2.7.1), or a small dwelling (in accordance with C2.9.1) that is the subject of a development proposal, the minimum and average site area of Table 3B may be reduced by up to 35 per cent, provided that: i. for grouped dwellings, no site is less than 100m2; and ii. the site area reduction is limited for small dwellings to a maximum 50 per cent of the total number of dwellings or sites.

exceptions.label: C4.1.4(i) area of a lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot approved by the WAPC
C4.1.4(ii) existing lot with permanent legal access to a public road
C4.1.5 small dwelling at R25 and below: minimum and average site area reduced by up to 35%
C4.1.6 gold-level accessible or small dwelling at R30 to R40: reduced by up to 35%, no site under 100 m2, at most 50% of 4 or more sites
C4.1.7 gold-level accessible or small dwelling at R50 and above: reduced by up to 35%, no site under 100 m2, small dwellings at most 50% of sites

verified.note: The R10-R25 averages (1000/800/666/571/450/350) are printed struck through in a pink box as a proposed change for Perth and Peel only (p54); whether they are operative is unresolved. C4.1.7(ii) 'the site area reduction is limited for small dwellings to a maximum 50 per cent of the total number of dwellings or sites' (p53) does not say how it applies to a single dwelling or lot or to gold-level accessible dwellings; the C4.1.7 exception keeps verify true.

notes: New to Chapter 3 (no Chapter 2 twin; Chapter 2 tests the average only on created lots). Average site area per dwelling across the grouped development (C4.1.1, Table 3B p54), sites calculated per C4.1.2(i) and C4.1.3. The R10-R25 averages (1000/800/666/571/450/350) are struck through with 'Proposed change: Removal of average site area for R10-R25 coded lots within the Perth and Peel Regions' (ch3-090): flagged only, kept operative, region all, verify true. R2-R5 and R100-SL: no average (null). C4.1.4 variations and C4.1.5 to C4.1.7 concessions as on C4.1.1; the 100 m2 floor is tested on the smallest dwelling site.
